headline: JaidynAlexis Admits ChriseanRock SHAPOWING Adam22 Was So Satisfying That She Found Herself
body: JaidynAlexis Admits ChriseanRock SHAPOWING Adam22 Was So Satisfying That She Found Herself Siding With Her! Jaidyn Alexis has social media talking after seemingly sharing her thoughts on the viral confrontation involving Chrisean Rock and Adam22. Jaidyn admitted On a stream that watching Chrisean allegedly put hands on Adam22 was so satisfying that she actually found herself siding with the one woman she never expected to defend. Is she wrong for this?
